args.query: bridge condition poor National Bridge Inventory

sql: SELECT "year", origin, SUM(passengers) AS pax FROM transport.t100_segments WHERE origin IN ('ORF','PHF') AND "year" IN (2015,2019,2024,2025) GROUP BY "year", origin ORDER BY "year", origin

SELECT "year", COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition='Poor' OR bridge_condition='P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poor, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition IN ('Poor','P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS pct FROM transport.bridges WHERE state_code='51' AND county_code IN ('550','650','700','710','740','800','810','830','735','073','093','095','199','181','175','620','735') AND record_type IN ('1','2') AND "year" IN (2017,2019,2021,2023,2024,2025) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT "year", COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition IN ('Poor','P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS poor, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN bridge_condition IN ('Poor','P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) AS pct FROM transport.bridges WHERE state_code='51' AND county_code IN ('550','650','700','710','740','800','810','830','735','073','093','095','199','181','175','620') AND record_type='1' AND "year" IN (2017,2019,2023,2025) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
